methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: The assessment of maturity of an organization in the management of energy consumption according to the EMMM Model is obtained through 40 questions

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Presents the Energy Management Maturity Model (EMMM): a 40-question self-assessment scored into a synthetic maturity indicator. Energy performance indicators are mentioned only incidentally; no EnPI/EnB measurement model is identified or characterised (v2.3 maturity-assessment exclusion).

paper_type.evidence_quote: The proposed Energy Management Maturity Model

stage1.notes: Example application is a pharmaceutical manufacturing site; the tool is explicitly universal across industry and services. 'Continuous' in the title means continuous improvement, not continuous-process industry.
